title: Hp500Backbone
description: Catalog row hp500-backbone 1.0.0: the calibrated engine evaluated on each of the ten HP500 surveys, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/hp500/backbone.py to data/derived/hp500/backbone.json. The engine is the canonical Python engine (pipeline.model.crusher) with calibrated true, the survey's measured closed-side setting and f80, and the HP500 nominal throw and speed; the measured block repeats the survey row. Derived from data licensed CC BY 4.0 (Rocha, Campos, Silva and Tavares 2024, https://doi.org/10.3390/min14090919). Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: n equals the number of surveys and the surveys are numbered 1 to n in order.

bond_power_kw.description: The classical Bond draw of the engine at the survey.

calibrated_power_kw.description: The paper's current-based form, 1.30 times the Bond draw plus 110 kW.

f80_model_mm.description: The f80 of the Rosin-Rammler feed the engine reconstructed from the measured f80.
